description: W3C ACT-Rules test cases used as fixtures for the diligent-assess browser checks (WO-G). Each case names the Diligent state the check is expected to record, which can differ from the ACT outcome; every difference carries a note. Cases with a non-null skipped_reason have no file on disk and are not tested.
